name: com.calmatax.mcp/modelo-210
title: Calma Tax: Modelo 210 for UK owners
description: Check if a UK owner of a Spanish home owes Modelo 210 and estimate the tax. No personal data.

tools.name: check_modelo_210
tools.description: Says whether the owner of a Spanish home likely owes a Modelo 210 for 2025, the deadline, and, with a catastral value, a rough tax range. The same answer as the free check on calmatax.com. Asks for no personal details.

owns_home_in_spain.description: Owns a home (or a share of one) in Spain.

lives.description: Where the owner is tax resident.

use.description: How the home was used in 2025 (default own_use_or_empty: holidays, family or empty).

filed_before.description: Has the owner submitted Modelo 210s for earlier years? (default unsure)

catastral_value.description: Optional valor catastral in euros, from the IBI bill, for a rough tax range.

tools.name: estimate_modelo_210
tools.description: Works out the 2025 Modelo 210 imputed-income tax, in euros, for one or more Spanish homes that are not let all year, with the formula shown, the deadline, the Calma Tax price and a link to the order form already filled in with these figures. The same maths as the calculator on calmatax.com. Asks for no personal details.

residence.description: Where the owner is tax resident: UK and other non-EU pay 24%, EU/EEA 19%.

catastral_value.description: Valor catastral in euros, from the property's IBI (council tax) bill, e.g. 85000.

rate.description: "1.1" if the town's catastral values were revised from 2012 on, "2" if not, "unsure" (default: 2% is used, the rate most homes pay).

owners.description: How many people own the home (default 1). Each owner has their own return for their share.

your_share_pct.description: The asking owner's share, if not equal shares (e.g. 50).

held.description: Owned all of 2025 (default), bought during 2025, or sold during 2025.

date.description: Date bought or sold in 2025, YYYY-MM-DD. Needed when held is bought_2025 or sold_2025.

days_rented.description: Days the home was let in 2025 (default 0). Let days are taken off; rent has its own returns.

missed_years.description: Optional earlier years never submitted (2021 to 2024) for the first property, to price the catch-up with Calma Tax. Tax for those years is not estimated here.

tools.name: get_calma_tax_service
tools.description: Describes the Calma Tax Modelo 210 service for non-resident owners of a Spanish home they don't rent out: price per property, what is included, missed years 2021 to 2024, the 2025 deadline and refunds, with the order-form link.

properties.description: Number of homes, to total the price (default 1).

missed_years.description: Earlier years never submitted, to price the catch-up.
